Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 5.4, 6.1, 7.3; courts B/D/J. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: M1 implementation.
Integration parent: bd-01M16KDH0TM7DF2BC0K08TH0TT; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7AZQZ4H1ZA7FEXHD0K21.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own shared inspector/evidence dock and navigation actions. Query the provider for alternatives, exact discontiguous source/recall support, typed absence and complete inverse references. Preserve the originating recall row when focusing a source candidate; do not rejoin display snippets.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. A nonwinning alternative reaches exact permitted evidence or explicit typed absence within two deliberate actions and returns to the same row/target/viewport.
2. All supplied alternatives and repeated inverse references remain accessible, including offscreen targets; inverse rows are not renormalized.
3. Grain, decision origin, fidelity/calibration availability and evidence kind remain distinct; denial and discontiguous-gap mutation checks pass.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Fall back to the provider-backed exact list/table without fabricating excerpts or collapsing support.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [M1] Add retained-context alternatives, exact evidence and inverse lookup
